Tests and benchmarks fd_chacha20_block with an RFC 7539 vector.

# Purpose
This file is a small test and benchmark program for `fd_chacha20_block`. The `test_chacha20_block` function uses a known ChaCha20 test vector from RFC 7539 and checks that the generated 64-byte block matches the expected output. The `bench_chacha20_block` function runs repeated calls to measure throughput and time per byte, then prints the results with the logging system. The `main` function starts the runtime with `fd_boot`, runs the test and benchmark, prints `pass`, and then stops the process with `fd_halt`.
